reviews.author: Ed Schulte
reviews.text:
From the initial sales process to final completion of my project, Aspenwood Landscape has proven to be a competent and trustworthy partner in addressing my landscaping needs.

I hired Aspenwood to tear out and replace 4300 square feet of sod.  Josiah came out to quote the job and his pricing was competitive.  He was also successful in convincing me to consider a new strain of rhizomatous tall fescue over blue grass, with the former being resistant to drought and requiring less water to maintain.  It looks great!

His crew worked extremely hard and paid attention to detail while completing the project.  Aspenwood had the right equipment to do an excellent job in soil prep, which included adding 15 tons of soil treatment.  At the completion of the project, Omar (their crew chief) was meticulous in adjusting the sprinkler heads to their original state.

Aspenwood Landscape is involved in other forms of landscaping, and I will be using them again in the future.
reviews.ownerResponse:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience—it means a lot to us. It was a pleasure helping you transform your yard, and we’re glad the switch to tall fescue is already proving to be a good move. We’re always focused on recommending practical, long-term solutions that make sense for both aesthetics and maintenance.

Big credit to Omar and the crew for their attention to detail throughout the install and wrap-up. We put a lot of thought into soil prep and irrigation adjustments, so it’s great to hear that those efforts stood out.

We really appreciate the trust you placed in us and look forward to working with you again on your next project!

—Josiah & the Aspenwood Team

reviews.author: Thach Quach (Tako)
reviews.text:
Josiah and the Aspenwood Landscape team did a wonderful job transforming our backyard into a fully useable space. From the initial design and tweaks along the way, they took what we had in mind and absolutely nailed it! We wanted an open and simpler concept than what the previous owners had done to the yard (train wreck of shrubs and a warped deck) and within a couple weeks, our backyard was brand new. They installed a beautiful paver patio, new sod, a new walkway from the front to the back yard, and a new rock perimeter. They really opened up the space exactly how we imagined it.

They were with us every step of the way and answered all our questions (and re-questions). They were transparent in pricing changes as well as flexible with any unplanned design adjustments. A great group who were always friendly and courteous, superb in their knowledge of landscaping. They were very efficient, always on time, on task, and on schedule. We've actually hired them again for a smaller job and the quality of their work still remains intact.

We highly recommend Aspenwood for all your landscaping needs, it's truly like pushing the "easy" button.
reviews.ownerResponse: Thank you for your review!
